Five local plugins "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"consolidated into one package, installed with a single dsh plugin add."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-toolkit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A consolidated plugin toolkit for the **DeepSeek Harness**. Five previously separate local plugins —"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" **session identity**, **global prompt**, **session auto-resume**, **Session-log button relocation**"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", and **peer-session messaging** — merged into a single installable package that ships in the offici"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"al bundle form (`dsh.bundle.patch`) and installs with `dsh plugin add`; it also includes a **Prompt "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"`dsh.bundle.patch`) and installs with `dsh plugin add`; it also includes a **Prompt Dedup** feature."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Current version: **1.0.0**, verified against **DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`** — which is also "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"its **minimum supported version** (**contract surfaces + the full gate suite — not a complete functi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"onal regression**): 0.1.6 and earlier fail loudly by design rather than degrading silently (see Comp"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"sion**): 0.1.6 and earlier fail loudly by design rather than degrading silently (see Compatibility)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Into any profile — a bundle layer, single source, no copies:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The package's `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) registers the single entry (`id: session-toolk"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"it`, `name: 'dsh-session-toolkit'`) as a **bundle layer** — applied after `dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app`"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" and before the profile patch layer (layer order: bundles in sequence → profile patch → home patch →"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" `--patch` overlay)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-toolkit`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### What you are installing"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Published on **npm** as `dsh-session-toolkit` (**latest published version: v1.0.0**, MIT) and mirror"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ed on **GitHub** at `github.com/Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit`. Pure-JS package — **no build step, n"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"o prepare script**. `files` whitelists `lib/`, `client/`, `cordis.patch.yml` and the READMEs."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> **npm carries the current version.** `1.0.0` is published, so `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-se"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ssion-toolkit` gives you the session-management tools (`create_session` / `rename_session`) and ever"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ything else described above. `0.1.9` and `0.1.10` were tagged but never reached npm; `0.1.11` was th"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"e first published version since `0.1.8`. Installing from this checkout or from GitHub (`dsh plugin -"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"-profile web add github:Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit`) is equivalent."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **npm**: consumers run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-toolkit`; new versions are releas"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ed with `npm publish` (or `pnpm publish`).
- **GitHub**: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Han-Ya"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"o94/dsh-session-toolkit`.
- **Tarball**: `pnpm pack` → `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-session-t"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"oolkit-<version>.tgz`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Local development"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Two families: **prompt layers** (what the model sees) and **session plumbing** (the tools and UI but"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"tons that drive sessions)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The plugin is verified against **DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`** — its **minimum supported vers"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ion** (**contract surfaces + the full gate suite, not a complete functional regression**; the declar"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ed dependency ranges, `^0.2.0-rc.1` for the harness packages and `^3.18.4` for schemastery, apply): "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"0.1.7 replaced the settings model (a plugin registering a namespace, read through `ctx.settingsScope"},{"id":"p25s5","text":".bind`) with entry `Config` `volatile` fields read through `ctx.configForms`, so the whole user-data"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" surface moved (see Settings fields). On 0.1.6 and earlier the client entry stays at `pending (waiti"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ng for service: configForms)` and `web boot` reports `Failed to load plugins` — a **loud failure** r"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ather than a silent degradation; upgrade the harness or uninstall this plugin. The existing fallback"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"s for `interpolate: false` and `ctx.sessionController.resolveAgent` are unchanged."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Framework**: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.4 and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.4 (the versions `ds"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"h-v0.2.0-rc.1` vendors). The `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` floor is `^3.18.4`: `volatile()` exists only"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" from 3.18.3, and earlier builds make the `Config` constructor throw. The plugin loads through the c"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ordis harness and registers as a bundle via `dsh.bundle.patch`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Client half is a hand-maintained single-file IIFE bundle; adding a feature touches both `lib/` and"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" `client/client.js`.
- **Identifier scope in the client half is now covered by a gate** — `scripts/s"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"cope-identifiers.assert.mjs` fails when an IIFE module block uses a module alias that the block itse"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"lf does not bind, and it is wired into CI (with `--selftest`); its documented boundary is that it ch"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ecks `require`-bound aliases only and does **not** prove that a button renders in a browser. Before "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"that gate existed the failure was invisible: a block that calls `react.useState` must also call `req"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"uire('react')`: `react/jsx-runtime` does not provide it, and a missing binding throws while the comp"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"onent renders. The slot renderer catches that throw and drops the entry, so the symptom is a button "},{"id":"p28s9","text":"that is silently not there -- not an error anyone sees. This shipped from 2026-09-18 (`3e44642`, whi"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ch added the hooks calls without adding the require) until 2026-09-22, through every gate.
- **A rec"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"eived peer message shows up as a collapsed row, not as a readable message.** `send_to_session` recor"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"ds the delivery with producer attribution — `source: { kind: 'agent-message', form: 'relay', senderS"},{"id":"p28s13","text":"essionId }` — and the client renders every non-human source through its turn-trigger row, which is c"},{"id":"p28s14","text":"ollapsed until you click it. Writing `kind: 'user'` instead would render inline like a human message"},{"id":"p28s15","text":", but would record another agent's words as the user's in the one field the V4 format made producer-"},{"id":"p28s16","text":"owned. The attribution wins; click the row to read the body (it still names its sender in the first "},{"id":"p28s17","text":"ibution wins; click the row to read the body (it still names its sender in the first line).
